Consulting

You shouldn’t be the thing holding it together.

More than one calendar. Tools you wired together yourself. Pieces that only stay in step because you keep them there. We design that into one system and build it with you, in phases, and you see what it takes before you book anything.

Which one is this?

A walkthrough

Connecting an inbox, a calendar and a chat app on one computer is an hour with us, and you leave able to run it and change it yourself. That is Guided Setup.

Design and build work · you are here

More than one calendar, tools you have already wired together, or several pieces that have to keep working without you in the middle. We scope it, quote the whole thing, then build it.

Either way

Both are $250 an hour. So the question is not which is cheaper. It is which one your setup is.

Who this is for

You already built something, and it works because you are standing in the middle of it.

You are not asking what an agent could do. You are asking whether these particular pieces can be made to hold together without you in the middle. None of that is about size: a person running a household, a rental and two side projects belongs here, and a ten-person company connecting one inbox does not.

How it goes

The plan arrives before the bill does.

1

The free call

We learn how the whole thing actually runs, and which parts an agent can reach. If we are the wrong tool, we say so on the call.

  • 30 minutes
  • Free, no card
  • Nothing to install yet
2

The scope, in writing

What gets connected, in what order, split into phases, with how many sessions each phase is estimated at. You read all of it before you book.

  • Yours to keep either way
  • Before any money moves
  • An estimate, not a quote
3

The build, in phases

One phase at a time, on the computer that will run it, with you there. Each piece is tested on its own rather than everything at once at the end.

  • $250 an hour
  • Billed as delivered
  • Stop after any phase
The catch

What this is not.

Not a fixed price

The session count is an estimate. It firms up once we know which accounts, what you need done inside each one, and which computer runs it. What you get instead of a guarantee is a trigger: if a phase runs longer than we said, you hear it before another session is booked, never on an invoice afterwards.

Not us working in the background

A build still happens in sessions, on the computer that will run it, with you there. Nothing gets constructed between calls and handed over finished.

Not everything you own

Some of what you run is out of an agent’s reach. Which parts, and what we would leave alone, is named on the free call, before you have paid for a phase that assumed otherwise.

Not open ended

It ends when it is built. A phase covers what we scoped with you, and anything afterwards, whether that is keeping it running or hardware that arrives later, is arranged separately and priced with you on the same rate, rather than folded into work you already agreed to.

Pricing

The same rate, quoted whole.

$250 an hour, one hour a session, the same rate as a Guided Setup session. An hour of our time costs the same whatever it is spent on, so the rate never rises with complexity. What changes is how much is decided before you spend anything.

Archie, separately

$30 a month or $299 a year, or $99 a month or $999 a year for Archie for Business. Archie is in testing. The waitlist hears the day it opens.

The AI account, billed to you

The AI your agent thinks with bills you directly at its own price, with nothing added by us. A setup this size is not a light user: measured, moderate use runs $44 to $63 a month and heavy use $130 to $204. We work out your own figure on the call, from what you actually want it doing. Every measured range is on the pricing page.

Stopping

Tell us, and you owe for the sessions already delivered and nothing else. Sessions are payment for our time and are not refunded once delivered, which is exactly why the call comes first and costs nothing. An Archie plan is a separate purchase and carries its own 14-day money-back guarantee under our Terms.

What you keep

Under our Terms, the configuration work, automations and documentation we build for you are yours to use and modify. The same Terms oblige us to publish a final version of Archie that needs no licence check within 30 days if we ever shut down.

Tell us what you are holding together.

Get My Agent Started

The 30-minute call is free, and the scope that comes out of it is yours whether you book a session or not. We are two people, so this is a handful of calls a week.

Secure AI agents, your way.
Easy plug-and-play, fully in your control.
